result.topic_en: Notes on the behaviour of the argument and logarithms of the functions X, Y, Z (u, y) near branch points and boundary lines of a minimal surface bounded by straight lines, including the case of two boundary lines meeting at angle απ and of parallel boundary lines meeting at infinity, with resulting logarithmic expansions.

methods.what: Local logarithmic behaviour of X and Z in terms of Y at a branch point of order n
methods.quote: $\log X = n \log Y + f.c.$ $\log Z = (n-1)\log Y + f.c.$

methods.what: Angle between successive boundary parts at such a point
methods.quote: macht der folgende Theil der Begrenzung mit dem vorhergehenden den Winkel $(n-1)\pi$.

methods.what: Local expansion at a corner where two straight boundary lines meet at angle απ
methods.quote:
$\frac{\alpha}{m}\log X = \log Y + f.c.$
$\log Z = (1 \pm \frac{\alpha}{m})\log X + f.c.$

methods.what: Condition for the surface to be tangent to the (Y,Z) plane
methods.quote:
Wenn die Fläche die $(Y,Z)$ Ebene tangiren soll
muss $\frac{\alpha}{m} < 1$ sein.

methods.what: Expansions for a surface extending to infinity between two boundary lines with common perpendicular of length A and angle απ
methods.quote:

$u = \sqrt{\frac{A}{2\alpha\pi}}\log z + f.c.$ [?]
$y = -\frac{A i}{4\alpha\pi}\frac{1}{z} + f.c.$
